{{Top}}
[[File:Club_Vertica_Casino.png|thumb|right|250px|The [[Club Vertica Casino]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]]]

A '''casino''' was a public location for [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]].

Casinos often used organic dealers for gambling games that required them, preferring to offer their customers a personal touch. However, automated [[Dealer droid/Legends|dealer droids]] gained popularity for a number of reasons. Firstly, they were cheaper and did not require payment for their services. Secondly, the players did not tip the droids in the same way they would an organic dealer, leading to more [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] being wagered at the gaming tables themselves. Lastly, dealer droids had sharp [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]] and advanced [[Processor/Legends|processors]] that allowed them to keep track of the game and spot potential cheaters.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
